# heraut whatsnew

Show release notes for versions newer than the running build.

Show the release notes of every heraut version newer than the one running. When GitHub can't be
reached it reads a local cache, then the changelog built into the binary, so it works offline too.

## Usage

```text
heraut whatsnew
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut whatsnew
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
